text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"SETO"—a keyword that would likely guide 
Neo Universe somewhere other than the 
Classic Triple Crown. Investigations to 
uncover its meaning were hitting a wall.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You then ask the "Monster" Oguri Cap, who 
became the strongest without winning the 
Classic Triple Crown: Can you become 
stronger by skipping the Triple Crown?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap says she should run in the 
Triple Crown, believing that competing 
against rivals of the same generation will 
surely lead to strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Believing this advice to be another 
crucial "crossroad," she reaffirmed her 
resolve to take on the Classic Triple 
Crown. First up: the Satsuki Sho.
